ancillaries.name: Tutor
ancillaries.description: A patient graybeard with a switch and a scroll case, hired to beat sums and syntax into a young gentleman. Some of it stuck.

ancillaries.name: Philosopher Companion
ancillaries.description: He dines at his patron's table and questions every decision made there. Annoying, but the decisions have improved.

ancillaries.name: Master of Rhetoric
ancillaries.description: A teacher of speeches who can make a grain tariff sound like destiny. His patron's words now land where they are aimed.

ancillaries.name: Scribe
ancillaries.description: Ink-stained and indispensable, he remembers what was promised to whom and files it where it can be found again.

ancillaries.name: Household Steward
ancillaries.description: He runs the estate so his master can run the province, and squeezes a profit out of both.

ancillaries.name: Quartermaster
ancillaries.description: A sour old soldier who counts every sack of barley twice. Columns he supplies do not straggle.

ancillaries.name: Wilderness Guide
ancillaries.description: Born in country the mapmakers gave up on. He knows the fords, the goat paths, and which valleys to never camp in.

ancillaries.name: Drillmaster
ancillaries.description: His voice can cross a parade ground against the wind. Formations he has trained wheel like a single animal.

ancillaries.name: Shieldbearer
ancillaries.description: A silent giant who stands a pace behind his general and takes professionally what was meant for another.

ancillaries.name: Field Surgeon
ancillaries.description: Quick with the probe and honest about the odds. Men fight harder knowing a wound need not be the end.

ancillaries.name: Standard Bearer
ancillaries.description: He has carried the standard through three routs without lowering it. Where it stands, the line stands.

ancillaries.name: Siege Engineer
ancillaries.description: He sketches a city's death on wax before supper. Rams, towers, and undermined corners are his correspondence.

ancillaries.name: Master of Horse
ancillaries.description: He judges a remount at forty paces and a cavalry officer faster than that. The squadrons have never been better mounted.

ancillaries.name: Catcher of Spies
ancillaries.description: A quiet man who notices new faces, counts doors, and asks the second question. Foreign agents find this city unlucky.

ancillaries.name: Food Taster
ancillaries.description: He eats first, pauses theatrically, and survives. Twice now, the pause was not theater.

ancillaries.name: Augur
ancillaries.description: He reads the flight of birds and the fold of a liver, and delivers heaven's opinion with a courtier's timing.

ancillaries.name: Priest of the War God
ancillaries.description: He blesses the blades the night before battle and marches in the front rank's dust. Soldiers fight differently when heaven is watching.

ancillaries.name: Priestess of the Hearth
ancillaries.description: Her presence in the household is a public vow of decency. Even the market gossips approve, and they approve of nothing.

ancillaries.name: Merchant Factor
ancillaries.description: An agent with correspondents in every port and a nose for shortage. Cargoes seem to arrive just as prices peak.

ancillaries.name: Harbor Pilot
ancillaries.description: He has run this coast in every weather it owns. Captains pay gladly, and the harbor turns ships around in half the time.

ancillaries.name: Mine Overseer
ancillaries.description: He can smell a rich vein through rock and a lazy foreman through a wall. Output rises wherever he descends.

ancillaries.name: Physician
ancillaries.description: Trained in the Greek manner: observation, regimen, and a deep suspicion of miracle cures. His patients mostly live, which is the highest praise the trade allows.

ancillaries.name: Architect
ancillaries.description: He carries a plumb line and strong opinions about drains. Cities he touches grow straighter, drier, and faster.

ancillaries.name: Flattering Courtier
ancillaries.description: He praises beautifully, arranges introductions, and takes a small consideration for each. Doors open; standards slip.

ancillaries.name: Captive Champion
ancillaries.description: A famous fighter taken in the sack who chose service over the block. The men admire him; sensible enemies avoid his master.

ancillaries.name: Exiled Prince
ancillaries.description: A dispossessed royal with beautiful manners and a claim someone might one day find useful. Courts listen when his host speaks.

ancillaries.name: Huntsman
ancillaries.description: He reads broken grass like a letter. Nothing approaches the camp that he has not already seen leave its den.

ancillaries.name: Informant
ancillaries.description: A forgettable face who buys drinks and sells what he hears. Half the city's secrets pass through his hands, lightly used.
